item.title: Behind the Challenges: My experience as a CTF challenge creator
item.description: I was introduced to the concept of a CTF during my Sophomore year in Systems Security (CY3740). This class was a practical take on security and had “challenges” as assignments. These challenges were certain tasks that we did and got a flag that you submitted for points. I found these challenges to be interesting, even though I was unable to do all of them, and they were engaging and my first real taste of hacking.
